nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Provides example environment variables for OpenAI access, local OCR runtime tuning, document limits, and provider retry behavior.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Records released and unreleased changes from version 0.1.0 through 0.5.0, including added features, behavior changes, fixes, and security updates.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Defines contributor setup, development and verification workflows, documentation expectations, pull-request guidance, and architecture constraints.

nodes.name: Launch-GLM-OCR.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that selects the GLM-OCR engine, forwards optional OpenAI settings into WSL, starts the OCR stack, and opens the Streamlit application.
nodes.languageNotes: Batch script propagates selected Windows environment variables through WSLENV before starting the WSL stack.

nodes.name: Launch-PaddleOCR-VL-1.6.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that selects PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, forwards optional OpenAI settings into WSL, starts the OCR stack, and opens the Streamlit application.
nodes.languageNotes: Batch script propagates selected Windows environment variables through WSLENV before starting the WSL stack.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project entry documentation covering installation, application and CLI usage, Markdown and JSON outputs, the public Python API, repository layout, and development resources.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States the project security policy and the supported channel for reporting security vulnerabilities.

nodes.name: SETUP.md
nodes.summary: Provides prerequisites, automated Windows installation, manual WSL setup, Luna configuration, environment-variable reference, verification, and troubleshooting guidance.

nodes.name: Setup-GLM-OCR.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows bootstrap wrapper that invokes the PowerShell installer in provisioning mode for the repository installation root.

nodes.name: grounded-docparse-threat-model.md
nodes.summary: Threat model for grounded-docparse that defines scope, assets, trust boundaries, entry-point controls, abuse paths, security invariants, and reassessment triggers.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines the Python package metadata, CLI entry point, dependencies, Linux local-OCR extras, uv package indexes, Hatch build settings, and pytest configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses uv source indexes to select CUDA or CPU PyTorch packages for mutually exclusive local-OCR extras.

nodes.name: security_best_practices_report.md
nodes.summary: Security assessment report documenting medium and low-risk findings, current controls, and deployment-boundary considerations for the application.
